hooks.command: g=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$g/claude-md-nudge"; now=$(date +%s); last=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 1); [ $((now-last)) -lt 10800 ] && exit 0; [ -z "$(git log --since=@$last --oneline 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; echo "$now" > "$f"; printf %s '{"decision":"block","reason":"Session checkpoint - review this session and propose CLAUDE.md updates while the context is fresh. Look for durable facts a future session would need: new modules, schema or env-var changes, conventions, or gotchas that cost time. Propose concrete edits and ask before applying them. If nothing durable changed, say so in one line and stop."}'
